Same-location actions MUST use identical background, camera distance, character size and placement; only limbs, hands, expressions and contacted props change. Travel/entry across locations may change environment deliberately to show the narrated progression. Original reference image is assets/images/stories/staying_safe.png. IDENTITY LOCK: Boy: tousled dark brown hair, warm peach skin, blue hoodie, charcoal shorts, white socks and dark shoes. Mother: long dark brown hair, pink blazer over pale pink top, blue trousers, brown shoulder bag. Preserve their exact faces; helper is an additional distinct adult. Narration for context, never print words: We stay with our trusted adults. We follow safety rules like looking both ways before we cross. Required location(s): sidewalk at marked road crossing. Emotion: attentive, calm. Props/contact: mother's hand, curb, zebra crossing, stopped traffic. LEFT FRAME: Boy holds mother's hand and turns head LEFT checking road; both feet stay on sidewalk behind curb. RIGHT FRAME: Same boy turns head RIGHT checking road while mother stays holding hand; both remain behind curb, cars stopped. Show ALL narrated beats in this ordered strip, each cel a distinct meaningful action pose. Use exact reference faces, hair, eye shape, skin, clothes, proportions and warm premium 2D children's cartoon rendering. Full uncropped heads with visible space ABOVE hair and around all active hands/props in EVERY frame; 10% safe margin around heads. Full body and feet visible for walking/sitting/standing actions. Keep hands anatomically coherent and props held or supported correctly. No text, speech bubbles, labels, numbers, watermark or logos. For toilet scenes conceal all private anatomy behind privacy partition or non-explicit clothing, never draw nudity. For roads child remains behind curb until adult checks safe crossing; never step into road on red pedestrian light. For personal space never hug or touch without consent. Asset id: staying_safe-p1. CRITICAL ROAD GEOMETRY: Unlike the original reference crossing pose, set both boy and mother ENTIRELY ON THE SIDEWALK in ALL cels. Sidewalk is a broad foreground safe island below a clearly visible raised CURB; roadway and zebra stripes are BEYOND that curb, behind them. Neither person's shoe nor foot may overlap road/zebra stripes. All cars remain in the road beyond curb and STOPPED. Full boy/mother heads, all hair, hands, shoes within cel with50px margin; use wide camera. Mother holds boy's hand continuously for look-both-ways and light waiting. Native pedestrian red/green symbols clear, no written text.
